title: 第十三章 侯紫的后怕
slug: 凡人修仙谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

船走了一夜。

天蒙蒙亮，侯紫醒了。他靠在粮袋上，手张着接风。风里有江水的腥气，芦苇的潮气，远处渡口的炊烟味。

船尾传来船桨划水的声音，一下，又一下。

沈君壁坐在对面，背挺得很直。脸上的淤青消了大半，眼眶还是青的。他手里摩挲着那块祖传玉佩，一言不发，像在酝酿着什么。

太阳从江面升起来，金色的光穿过船舱缝隙，在地板上投下一道细长的影子。

沈君壁开口了。

声音压得很低，刚好能被侯紫听见，不会飘到船尾。

“我叫沈君壁。”他像在宣告。

“沈家是云霄阁的附庸家族。祖上出过一位金丹修士，三代无人觉醒灵根，被宗门抛弃。三年前，韩家夜袭沈家祖宅，我运气好，正好因为没灵根，被父亲赶去太学府，准备考功名。”沈君壁嘴角浮起一丝自嘲。

“那晚，沈家上下老少三百多口人全被灭了，我是沈家最后一个活人。”

侯紫没说话。他想起小石头，小石头被一掌拍死在破庙里的时候，也是这样，连惨叫都没发出来。在修士眼里，凡人和老鼠没区别。

“我逃到汉口镇蹲了三年，苦了三年，一直等一个愿意带我去上界的修士。也许上界有让我能修炼的办法，这是我能想到的唯一出路。”沈君壁苦笑了下。

“昨晚在码头，我看见你出手。你能操控风势，又出手救了凡人，我能确定你和大多数修士的不同。所以我跟你摊牌。”

侯紫心里清楚。沈君壁说的是真话，这么重大的秘密不可能随便透露，有豁出去的想法。

他从怀里摸出一颗灵石，放在两人中间的粮袋上。

“这是什么？”

沈君壁看了一眼。“下品灵石。修士用来修炼，也用来当钱。一块够在散修坊市住一晚最好的客栈。”

他顿了顿，声音更低了。

“金子那些在修仙界，连一颗最低级的聚气丹都买不到。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The boat traveled all night.

It was dawn and Hou Zi woke up.He leaned against the grain bag and opened his hands to catch the wind.In the wind there is the fishy smell of the river, the moisture of the reeds, and the smell of cooking smoke from the ferry in the distance.

The sound of oars paddling came from the stern of the boat, once, and again.

Shen Junbi sat opposite, with his back straight.Most of the bruises on his face were gone, but his eyes were still blue.He was stroking the ancestral jade pendant in his hand without saying a word, as if he was brewing something.

The sun rises over the river, and its golden light passes through the gaps in the cabin, casting a slender shadow on the floor.

Shen Junbi spoke.

The voice was very low, just enough to be heard by Hou Zi and not float to the stern of the boat.

"My name is Shen Junbi." He seemed to be announcing.

"The Shen family is a vassal family of Yunxiao Pavilion. There was a golden elixir monk in our ancestors. No one in three generations had awakened his spiritual roots and was abandoned by the sect. Three years ago, the Han family attacked the Shen family's ancestral home at night. I was lucky. Just because I had no spiritual roots, my father drove me to the Taixue Academy to prepare for the merit examination." There was a trace of self-mockery on Shen Junbi's lips.

"That night, more than 300 members of the Shen family, old and young, were wiped out. I was the last living member of the Shen family."

Hou Zi said nothing.He thought of Xiao Shitou. When Xiao Shitou was slapped to death in the ruined temple, it was the same way. He didn't even scream.In the eyes of monks, there is no difference between mortals and rats.

"I fled to Hankou Town and hunkered down for three years. I suffered for three years, waiting for a monk who was willing to take me to the upper world. Maybe there is a way for me to practice in the upper world. This is the only way out I can think of." Shen Junbi smiled bitterly.

"Last night at the pier, I saw you take action. You could control the wind, and you took action to save mortals. I can confirm that you are different from most monks. So I have a showdown with you."

Hou Zi knew it.Shen Junbi was telling the truth. Such a major secret could not be revealed casually, and he had the intention of risking his life.

He took out a spiritual stone from his arms and placed it on the grain bag between the two of them.

"What is this?"

Shen Junbi took a look."Low-grade spiritual stone. Monks use it for cultivation and as money. One piece is enough to stay in the best inn in Sanxiufang City for one night."

He paused and his voice became even lower.

"In the realm of immortal cultivation, those of Jin cannot even buy the lowest level Qi Gathering Pill."
